name: @openpep/protocol-schema
description: Schemas and validators for the openpep-vault protocol

scripts.test: npm run build --silent && node --test dist/test/appointment.test.js dist/test/canonical.test.js dist/test/checkpoint.test.js dist/test/clinical-document.test.js dist/test/clinical-event.test.js dist/test/ids.test.js dist/test/ledger.test.js dist/test/operations-manifest.test.js dist/test/patient.test.js dist/test/progressive-summary-work.test.js dist/test/signing-keys.test.js dist/test/vault-directory.test.js dist/test/yaml.test.js dist/test/vault.test.js
scripts.validate:fixtures: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/validate-fixtures.js ../../fixtures/vault-v1 vault && node dist/src/validate-fixtures.js ../../fixtures/operations-manifest-v1 operations && node dist/src/validate-fixtures.js ../../fixtures/patient-v1 patient && node dist/src/validate-fixtures.js ../../fixtures/appointment-v1 appointment
